This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal ↗.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

Note Before you start using DocStudio, user must download the stand-alone app.Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.

  1. Make sure you see instructions page.
  2. Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
  3. Click ⚙️icon on the top left, to edit GitHub Settings.
  4. Fill the details as shown below then click Connect.
    1. Owner: axtroid
    2. Repo: documentation
    3. Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
    4. Branch: main
    5. Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)


Important The application must be restarted to load the latest content from the server.
